note: Vertical -> donor routing for the Mirror Engine. The engine itself (lib/mirror-engine/donor.js) matches ONE exact string: String(BOILERPLATE.vertical).toLowerCase() === facts.industry. That covers a canonical vertical and nothing else, so 'deck', 'masonry' and 'hardscaping' had no route even though a donor exists for each. This file is the alias table; lib/donor-verticals.js reads it and api/mirror.js applies it by naming the donor explicitly on the request. The engine is NOT modified — an explicit donor name is a first-class field of the mirror request and is path-confined by the engine exactly as before.
canonical_note: Authoritative primary donor per Command Center vertical; explicit donor requests and aliases remain unchanged.
aliases_note: Keys are compared lower-cased and whitespace-collapsed against facts.industry. A key that is ALSO a canonical vertical is ignored by lib/donor-verticals.js — the engine's own resolution always wins, so this table can never silently redirect an industry the engine already handles.
retired_note: Roofing sat here 2026-07-30 through 2026-08-20 (owner retired the category; the donor manifest carried vertical '__retired__roofing' and facts.industry='roofing' 404ed). The live manifest now says vertical 'roofing', retired:false — the Falcon verbatim port (2026-08-17) returned roofing to service, this file's canonical block routes it, and the old block's claims were stale documentation contradicting the manifest. The manifests stay the authority: retiring a vertical again means changing its BOILERPLATE.json vertical, then recording it here.
